queue.construct: std.fmt.bufPrint(&message, "lang: duplicate id '{s}'\n", .{id}) catch unreachable  (also :221 for 'unknown id')
queue.reason: Pure formatting into an 8256-byte stack buffer sized above the 8 KiB head buffer plus the format text, so NoSpaceLeft cannot happen. It guards no I/O boundary. It is an assertion, not handling, and the only alternative (`try`) is the same size.
queue.riskIfWrong: None if kept. If someone later grows in_buf past 8192 without growing `message`, `unreachable` becomes a panic in safe builds.
